title: 18-Inch Towel Bar Wall Mount, Powder Coated Pipe | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop draping towels over doors and counters—this 18-Inch towel bar keeps bath towels neatly hung, within reach, and off the floor while adding an industrial pipe-fitting detail to your bathroom.

  • Keep towels organized with a sturdy, wall-mounted bar sized for everyday use.
  • Coordinate your space with the Pipeline towel bars collection—transitional bathroom hardware that suits modern and traditional decor.
  • Maintain a clean, decorative finish with a highly durable powder coat.
  • Built for lasting performance with corrosion-free and rust-free materials.
  • Install with a matched look using color-coordinated mounting hardware.

Specs & Installation

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 3 x 3.3 in.
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 24 x 5 x 5 in.
  • Shipping weight: 2.2 lbs
  • Finish: powder coated (finish varies by selection)
  • Warranty: limited lifetime warranty

_previous.description: The Pipeline collection is the latest innovation for bathroom fittings from the Allied Brass Brand of products. This towel bar gives the industrial look of pipe fittings while blending aptly with both modern and traditional bathroom decor. This accessory is powder coated with lifetime materials to provide a decorative and clean finish. No wonder, this towel bar gives continual service for years without any trouble. The choice of superior materials makes this item free from corrosion and rust. Towel bar mounts firmly with color coordinating screws and comes with a limited lifetime warranty.
